_provenance.why: V1.4 W4 overlay. NEVER merged into packs/physics/caps.json, which feeds Tier A and its 0.000 wrong-fire baseline.
_provenance.note: The spec's canonical example, distance = speed * time, is NOT in this pack. The same-shape hazards that ARE present are extensive quantities accumulated over a run: p*t, i*t, f*d. Each computes as if the run were single, continuous and one-way. Conditions are authored for those, and for simple_interest, where a repetition marker signals compounding the capability does not model.
_provenance.coverage: 4 of 58 capabilities. Deliberately narrow: an unconditioned capability keeps V1.3 behaviour, so ablation C3 measures exactly what these four buy.

electrical_energy.rationale: power x time is energy only if the power was drawn continuously over that one interval. Intermittent or repeated operation makes the product an overestimate.

charge_from_it.rationale: same shape as p*t: a single continuous interval.

work_from_force.rationale: the clearest case in this pack. Work is force through DISPLACEMENT; over a round trip the net displacement is zero and f*d is not merely imprecise but answering a different question. Dimensionally impeccable throughout.

simple_interest.rationale: a repetition marker (each year, per year) is the signature of compounding, which this capability does not model. bred_final_amount does.
